**Short answer:** If the Promoter fails to give possession of the Apartment/Plot except due to a Force Majeure event, the Promoter is liable to return the total amount received, along with interest at the rate specified in the Rules, within ninety days, allowing the Allottee to withdraw from the Project [D24]. If the Promoter fails to provide ready to move in possession, the Promoter is considered in default, and the Allottee can stop making further payments, after which the Promoter must complete the construction milestones before the Allottee is required to make the next payment [D29][D30].

**What your document says:**
* If the Promoter fails to complete or is unable to give possession of the Apartment/Plot for any reason other than a Force Majeure event, the Promoter must return the total amount received to the Allottee, with interest at the rate specified in the Rules, within ninety days, allowing the Allottee to withdraw from the Project [D24].
* If the Promoter fails to provide ready to move in possession of the Apartment/Plot, the Promoter is considered in default [D29].
* If the Promoter defaults under the listed conditions, the Allottee has the option to terminate the Agreement, and the Promoter must refund the entire money paid by the Allottee, along with interest at the rate specified in the Rules, within ninety days of receiving the termination notice [D30].
* If the Promoter fails to hand over possession of the Apartment/Plot, the Promoter shall be liable, on demand to the allottees, to return the total amount received, with interest at the rate specified in the Rules, within ninety days, including compensation as provided under the Act [D24].
* If the Project completion is delayed due to Force Majeure conditions, the Allottee agrees that the Promoter is entitled to an extension of time for delivery of possession, unless the Force Majeure conditions make it impossible for the contract to be implemented, in which case the allotment stands terminated, and the Promoter must refund the entire amount received within ninety days from the date of termination [D20].

**What to check:** The specific dates and conditions for the refund and interest calculation are detailed in the document, and the Allottee should review the sections regarding Force Majeure and default for complete details [D20][D24][D30].
